name: Bulk edit per-operation schema validation settings
description: Bulk edit per-operation schema validation settings Updates schema validation settings for multiple API operations in a single request. PATCH /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/schema_validation/settings/operations
context:
PATCH /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/schema_validation/settings/operations
Updates schema validation settings for multiple API operations in a single request. Efficient for applying consistent validation rules across endpoints.
Required: zone_id (path); body (body)

name: Upload a schema

context:

name: Delete per-operation schema validation setting
description: Delete per-operation schema validation setting Removes custom schema validation settings for a specific API operation, reverting to zone-level defaults. DELETE /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/schema_validation/settings/operations/{operation_id}

name: Delete a schema
description: Delete a schema Permanently removes an uploaded OpenAPI schema from API Security. DELETE /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/schema_validation/schemas/{schema_id}

name: Set schema validation state
description: Set schema validation state Enables or disables validation for an uploaded OpenAPI schema without changing the schema document. PATCH /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/schema_validation/schemas/{schema_id}

name: Edit global schema validation settings
description: Edit global schema validation settings Partially updates global schema validation settings for a zone using PATCH semantics. PATCH /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/schema_validation/settings
context:
PATCH /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/schema_validation/settings
Partially updates global schema validation settings for a zone using PATCH semantics.
Required: zone_id (path); body (body)

name: Retrieve all operations from the schema
description: Retrieve all operations from the schema Retrieves all operations from the schema. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/schema_validation/schemas/{schema_id}/operations
context:
GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/schema_validation/schemas/{schema_id}/operations
Retrieves all operations from the schema. Operations that already exist in API Shield Endpoint Management will be returned as full operations.
Required: zone_id (path); schema_id (path) — The unique identifier of the schema
Optional: feature (query) — Add feature(s) to the results. The feature name that is given here corresponds to the resulting feature object. Have a look at the top-level object description for more details on the specific meaning.; host (query); method (query); endpoint (query); page (query) — Page number of paginated results.; per_page (query) — Maximum number of results per page.; operation_status (query) — Filter results by whether operations exist in Web Asset Management or not. `new` will just return operations from the schema that do not exist otherwise. `existing` will just return operations from the schema that already exist.

name: Get per-operation schema validation setting
description: Get per-operation schema validation setting Retrieves the schema validation settings configured for a specific API operation. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/schema_validation/settings/operations/{operation_id}

name: Get details of a schema
description: Get details of a schema Gets the contents and metadata of a specific OpenAPI schema uploaded to API Security. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/schema_validation/schemas/{schema_id}
context:
GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/schema_validation/schemas/{schema_id}
Gets the contents and metadata of a specific OpenAPI schema uploaded to API Security.
Required: zone_id (path); schema_id (path) — The unique identifier of the schema
Optional: omit_source (query) — Omit the source-files of schemas and only retrieve their meta-data.
